assertion_audit.assertions: Unidentified real held lock refuses replacement, emits refusal and sends no signals through the actual updated signal primitive.
assertion_audit.fails_if: Bypassing unidentified-owner refusal returns success, logs no refusal or calls _signal_one, breaking the corresponding assertion.

assertion_audit.assertions: An actual lock on fd8 plus an independently opened fd9 is held but does not authorise sampler replacement; fixture process survives and refusal is reported.
